title: Fielding as Run Prevention: Measuring the Hidden Value of Kolkata Knight Riders’s Saves
dek: How many runs do Kolkata Knight Riders' fielders save? The scorebook records run outs, catches and byes; it does not record the dive on the boundary. Here is what can and cannot be measured.
excerpt: Kolkata Knight Riders have effected more run outs per innings than the league since 2022. The most valuable fielding, the boundary save, is still invisible in public data.
author: CricField Editorial Desk
keyTakeaways: KKR have effected {{ev:fld-tro}} run outs per bowling innings since 2022, against {{ev:fld-lro}} for the rest of the IPL.
They have held {{ev:fld-tct}} catches per innings, against {{ev:fld-lct}} league-wide.
Byes and leg-byes conceded: {{ev:fld-tby}} per innings, against {{ev:fld-lby}}.

sections.heading: The Invisible Discipline
body: Fielding is the part of T20 cricket that public data measures worst. The scorebook records a run out and a catch; it does not record the single that was not taken because of a fast pick-up, or the four that became a two after a dive.

What can be measured is still useful. Across {{ev:fld-inns}} KKR bowling innings since 2022, the side has effected {{ev:fld-tro}} run outs per innings against {{ev:fld-lro}} for the rest of the league.

sections.heading: Catches, Run Outs and Leakage
body: Kolkata Knight Riders have held {{ev:fld-tct}} catches per bowling innings against {{ev:fld-lct}} elsewhere. Catches depend on chances created, so the figure mixes fielding with bowling.
Byes and leg-byes, a rough measure of wicketkeeping and line discipline, run at {{ev:fld-tby}} per innings against {{ev:fld-lby}} for the league.

sections.heading: Where Fielding Value Hides
body: The largest fielding contribution is runs not conceded: boundaries cut off and singles denied. Those require event-level fielding data that Cricsheet does not provide.
For KKR, a practical step is to log boundary saves and misfields in-house each match, turning coaching impressions into a run-prevention number.

sections.heading: Why Raw Counts Mislead
body: Run outs depend on how often opponents take risky singles, and catches on how many chances bowlers create. A side facing aggressive running sides will record more run outs without fielding any better.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Measure What the Scorebook Misses
body: The available counts put Kolkata Knight Riders ahead of the league on run outs since 2022. The bigger prize is the unmeasured one: runs saved in the field.
A franchise that tracks fielding events itself will have an advantage in selection that public data cannot match.

hypotheses.statement: Hypothesis: boundary saves and denied singles are worth more runs per match than run outs and catches combined.
hypotheses.whyUnverified: Fielding events other than dismissals are not recorded in Cricsheet data.
hypotheses.howToTest: Log fielding events from video for a sample of matches and value each in runs.

methodology: Regulation innings only (super overs excluded). Economy uses runs charged to the bowler (byes and leg-byes excluded) per legal ball times six. Bowler wickets exclude run outs. Generated from the CricField warehouse by scripts/editorial/engine. Fielding counts use the fielding side's bowling innings since 2022. Cricsheet data does not identify fielders, so individual fielding is not assessed.
